queries: WITH cte AS (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY id) as rn FROM prm_organization) DELETE FROM prm_organization WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM cte WHERE rn > 1);
ALTER TABLE prm_organization ADD CONSTRAINT uq_prm_organization_code UNIQUE (code);
